entities.summary: Éditions Denoël is a French publishing house founded in 1930. Acquired by Éditions Gallimard in 1951, it publishes collections spanning fiction, non-fiction and comic books. It published some of the most important French authors of the interwar period, including Louis-Ferdinand Céline, Louis Aragon and Antonin Artaud. Éditions Denoël is a publishing house in Paris, established in 1930-04-10. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
